title: ok3d settings
description: Every setting ok3d has. Helm checks settings.yaml against this before anything is deployed, and docs/settings.md is made from the descriptions here.

global.description: Set by Helm itself; not a setting.

settingsVersion.description: The version of the settings' layout. This release reads version 1.

cluster.description: The k3d cluster ok3d runs in.

name.description: The cluster's name: lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, starting with a letter, up to 32 characters.

k3sImage.description: The k3s image, pinned to a version (never latest). Kubernetes 1.37 or newer.

network.description: The Docker network the cluster's containers join.

apiPort.description: The Kubernetes API's port, on 127.0.0.1 only.

publishAddress.description: The address the web pages are published on: 0.0.0.0 for every address this machine has, or one IPv4 address.

dataRoot.description: The folder that holds everything ok3d keeps. An absolute path with no spaces or quotes.

mode.description: self-issued: ok3d makes its own certificate authority. (Public certificates come in 1.1.)

domain.description: The domain the web pages are named under, such as noc.home.arpa.

modules.description: The parts you can switch on or off. Each is off by default.

plex.description: Plex, watched as a service on your network (0.7).

snmp.description: Switches and NAS that aren't UniFi, through SNMP (0.7).

syslog.description: Syslog from your devices, over UDP and TCP (0.6).

mesh.description: Istio ambient between the cluster's parts (0.8).

remoteAccess.description: Tailscale, to reach ok3d away from home (0.8).
